title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Overview

Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil) at Articul8 AI. You will shape GenAI-based solutions, working with customers' technical and business leaders to understand gaps and objectives, and craft scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures.

About us

At Articul8 AI, we relentlessly pursue excellence and create exceptional AI products that exceed customer expectations. We are a team of dedicated individuals who take pride in our work and strive for greatness in every aspect of our business. We believe in using our advantages to make a positive impact on the world and inspiring others to do the same.

Job Description

Articul8 AI is seeking an exceptional Solution Architect to join us in shaping the future of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). You will work within the Product Technology team with customers’ technical and business leaders to understand their technical gaps, needs, and business objectives. You will craft GenAI-based solutions that promote innovation and accelerate bringing new products to market. This role offers opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to drive enterprise-grade GenAI innovations.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Design: Develop detailed, scalable architectural designs addressing client needs using Articul8 products and third-party tools.
  • Piloting and Prototyping: Run pilot programs with customers to demonstrate feasibility and advantages; introduce new features or build prototypes as needed.
  • Client Interaction: Engage with clients through workshops, meetings, and presentations to communicate solutions and best practices.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize for performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness; select instance types, auto-scaling configurations, and storage options.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions meet security best practices and regulatory requirements; implement IAM, data encryption, and related measures.
  • Documentation and Training: Create comprehensive architecture documentation and provide training to clients or internal teams.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with Applied Research, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Customer Success to maintain product technology leadership.
  • Leadership: Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of rapid innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience: 2+ years in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructure; 4+ years in technology domains such as software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics.
  • Education: BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technology stack: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); Languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Ruby); APIs/Integration (OpenAPI, FastAPI, Swagger, Flask, REST); Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis); ML Frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras); Development/Deployment (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes); Monitoring/Logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK); Version Control (Git, GitHub, GitLab); Architecture Design/Modeling (Microsoft Visio, Drawio); Collaboration/Project Management (JIRA, Confluence, Trello).
  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or related fields preferred.
  • Experience developing tools, libraries, and infrastructure for data preprocessing, model training/finetuning, and deployment of LLMs in research and production environments.

Professional Attributes

  • Problem Solving: Breaks down complex problems into manageable components and devises creative solutions with iterative refinement.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively in cross-functional teams, communicates clearly, and respects diverse perspectives.
  • Project Management and Prioritization: Balances multiple projects, sets milestones, and monitors progress; allocates time efficiently between short- and long-term goals.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluates assumptions, questions methodologies, and remains skeptical when interpreting results.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Maintains a proactive approach to learning and staying updated on related fields.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Intellectual Humility: Demonstrates empathy, resilience, adaptability, self-awareness, and collaboration.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary and benefits package, along with:

  • Professional development opportunities, including training and mentorship programs
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote options
  • Access to the latest technologies and tools
  • Regular social events and team-building activities
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment

Note: This position is available via CLT contract only.

title: Director - Revenue Cycle Continuous Improvement
description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and direct comprehensive revenue cycle-wide processes, including but not limited to denials & write-off prevention, vendor management, data insights, and systems applications support teams.
  • Provide strategic analysis and interpretation of critical revenue cycle data, identifying process improvement opportunities and monitoring performance against targets.
  • Conduct risk assessments to achieve KPI targets, report identified risks to senior management and provide strategic recommendations for mitigation.
  • Lead the coordination with operational leaders, managed care, vendor management, and other stakeholders to development of action plans aimed at achieving top decile metric performance.
  • Oversee the development and management of A/R and performance improvement issues logs, quantifying the impact of improvement initiatives, and prioritizing solutions within a functional area.
  • Provide operational leaders with strategic data and insights to drive targeted actions for metric improvement.
  • Develop and present comprehensive status reports and action-oriented summaries for executive leaders across the system.
  • Actively participate and co-lead metric and project calls with senior management and support staff.
  • Create and deliver high-quality presentations and updates for senior leaders across the health system.
  • Act as a liaison between data analytics and functional experts across the revenue cycle and health system to identify and drive forward measurable performance improvement.
  • Develop, recommend, and oversee the implementation and administration of policies and procedures. Evaluate processes and procedures and coordinate with the management team to ensure areas of focus adhere to federal and local laws and regulations.
  • Coordinate with IT to ensure continuous data availability and file needs.

Required Skills

  • Proven analytical and critical thinking skills required to synthesize complex data sets and interpret qualitative and quantitative data and trends to implement recommendations resulting in measurable performance improvement and successful organizational change.
  • Exceptional ability to create and deliver impactful presentations, tailoring messages for a variety of leaders and roles with the system.
  • Proven capability to manage complex multi-workstream performance improvement projects while delegating and overseeing the work of junior team members.
  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership.
  • Advanced knowledge of revenue cycle functions and payer denials with the ability to collaborate with team members and counterparts to understand business challenges, adapt implementation methodologies to ensure alignment with the client’s business objectives.
  • Extensive experience in building talent, training, supervising, coaching/mentoring, and performance management.

Core Qualifications

  • Current permanent U.S. work authorization required.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Limited travel required.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Extensive leadership experience.
  • 8-10 years of healthcare operations leadership and/or consulting experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience directing a department and/or team-based projects with a focus on performance improvement initiatives and change management, OR
  • Project leadership and workplan management experience within a consulting firm setting with a focus on hospital or physician revenue cycle, and denials management.
  • Experience managing both onshore and offshore staff.

Candidate Qualities

  • Advanced knowledge of revenue cycle processes.
  • Strong understanding of revenue cycle metrics and the levers that drive them in the patient access, patient financial services, and HIM/coding environment.
  • Ability to design and apply conceptual models to business problems to understand issues and support with reporting and analytics.
  • Effective and efficient organization and planning skills with the proven ability to manage complex multi-workstream performance improvement projects, while delegating and overseeing the work of junior team members.
  • Proven analytical and critical thinking skills required to synthesize complex data sets and interpret qualitative and quantitative data and trends to implement recommendations resulting in measurable performance improvement and successful organizational change.
  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership.
  • Ability to collaborate with team members and client counterparts to understand business challenges, adapt implementation methodologies and approaches to ensure results align with the client’s business objectives.
  • Team leadership experience including building talent, training, supervising, coaching/mentoring, and performance management.

Compensation and Benefits

The estimated salary range for this job is $130,000 - $170,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy and Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

title: Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions)
description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Lilly Catalyze360, a Division of Lilly Research Laboratories, is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem, agnostic of the therapeutic area. There are four pillars: Lilly Gateway Labs, ExploR&D, Lilly Ventures and Lilly TuneLab. Learn more about Catalyze360 at:

Lilly Gateway Labs links Lilly to an entrepreneurial community fostering innovation. It provides biotech companies direct access to Lilly scientists and expertise, opportunities to collaborate on projects of mutual interest, and learning forums with Lilly experts and partners, with potential for financial investment from Lilly or venture funds. Learn more at:

ExploR&D is a drug development organization within Catalyze360 focused on catalyzing the biotechnology ecosystem. It advances investigational medicines for external sponsors with speed and efficiency and supports programs across North America, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at:

Lilly Ventures maintains relationships with life science-focused funds to gain access to emerging science, with three portfolios (Therapeutics, Technology, and Impact) and investment tools including fund partnerships and direct investments.

Lilly TuneLab provides access to AI/ML tools leveraging Lilly's drug discovery models.

Position

The successful candidate for the Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions) will be a core member of Lilly’s legal team, helping drive the company’s mission and serving as a trusted advisor and leader to the Catalyze360 team. The role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately to Lilly’s growth and success. We seek a proven leader who is motivated, proactive, thrives in ambiguity, self-starting, and enjoys challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

This position provides legal support for the Lilly Gateway Labs and ExploR&D capabilities of Catalyze360 and will have the following responsibilities:

  • Lead the structuring, drafting, negotiating and counseling on transactions (including licenses and collaborations, R&D services, equity investments, divestitures and other transactions).
  • Serve as both a legal and business partner in structuring and implementing new Catalyze360 offerings and transaction models.
  • Develop agreement templates and playbooks and lead training for the Catalyze360 team.
  • Identify and resolve critical legal and business issues throughout the lifecycle of Catalyze360 agreements, including post-transaction alliance management support.
  • Partner with the Catalyze360 team and other internal stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and support the growth of the Catalyze360 organization.
  • Exercise excellent judgment to influence and drive decision-making.
  • Cultivate and contribute to the development of a high-performance transactions legal team and a collaborative culture with colleagues in the legal department and other key functions.
  • Demonstrate a service-oriented approach to advising internal client groups.
  • Serve as a recognized source of innovative ideas in complex areas of law, business, or technology with respect to transactional matters.

Basic Requirements

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to the bar in at least one state.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of legal experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated transactions in either a law firm or in-house, or a combination of both.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex transaction agreements in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry (including CRO and CDMO agreements).
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not sponsor work authorization or visas for this role.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities for creative and innovative solutions to transactional issues and process improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and business judgment with the ability to influence others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage internal client expectations and collaborate in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment.
  • Professional demeanor with the gravitas to lead and influence a seasoned business team.
  • Fast, nimble, and able to pivot between audiences to provide timely legal and business advice.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative, and capable of working independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects with priorities and deadlines.
  • Analytical and strategic with the ability to devise creative solutions to drive toward recommendations and closure.
  • Impeccable integrity and ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to lead outside counsel selection and oversee legal costs.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities actively engage in the workforce and provides accommodation requests for the application process at: Lilly is an EEO employer and does not discriminate on disability or other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) provide support networks for all employees. Current groups include Africa, Middle East, Central Asia Network; Black Employees at Lilly; Chinese Culture Network; Japanese International Leadership Network; Lilly India Network; Organization of Latinx at Lilly; PRIDE; Veterans Leadership Network; Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly; enAble. Learn more about all groups.

Actual compensation will depend on education, experience, skills, and location. The anticipated wage for this position is $177,000 - $259,600. Full-time employees are eligible for a company bonus and a comprehensive benefits program, including 401(k), pension, medical/dental/vision, flexible spending accounts, life and death benefits, and various time-off benefits. Lilly reserves the right to amend compensation and benefits programs as needed.

Afinal, um legado significativo é construída por pessoas e resultados incríveis. Desbloqueie a sua jornada. Vem pra Nomad!

Experiências e habilidades necessárias

  • Estar cursando ensino superior em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Vontade de aprender sobre riscos, controles internos, mercado financeiro e regulação;
  • Perfil detalhista e organizado, com atenção a minúcias;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por temas regulatórios e de governança.

No Seu Dia a Dia Vamos Te Empoderar Para

  • Apoiar na elaboração, revisão e monitoramento de controles internos e processos da companhia;
  • Auxiliar na execução de testes de controles e mapeamento de riscos;
  • Contribuir com a organização de evidências para auditorias internas e externas;
  • Apoiar a equipe na interpretação de normativos regulatórios e sua aplicação nos processos internos;
  • Elaborar relatórios, planilhas e apresentações para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
  • Interagir com diferentes áreas da empresa, desenvolvendo visão ampla do negócio.

O que mais tem na mala de quem é Nomad?

Benefício flexível: Crédito mensal de R$1700 no cartão Flash para você usar com refeição, alimentação, cursos, mobilidade, academias e por aí vai.

Licença parental estendida: São 6 meses para pais e mães desbravarem o mundo com filhos(as) exclusivamente biológicos ou adotivos.

  • Auxílio-creche: R$460 mensais para filho(as) exclusivamente biológicos ou adotivos com até 5 anos de idade.

Para focar na saúde física e mental: Parceria com Wellhub (ex-Gympass) e TotalPass que dá acesso a academias e até sessões de terapia. No TotalPass você também pode incluir até 3 dependentes, com ou sem vínculo familiar.

Day off de aniversário: No mês do seu aniversário você tem a liberdade de curtir o seu dia, do seu jeito, de folga remunerada.

Cliente VIP: Nomads têm taxa de serviço zero no aplicativo, acesso VIP no Nomad Lounge e cupom de indicação para outras pessoas abrirem a conta.

A Nomad também ajuda a cuidar do seu pet: Com a Guapeco, você tem acesso a benefícios para a saúde e bem-estar do seu bichinho.

Seguro de vida e mais benefícios: Além da cobertura do seguro de vida, há desconto em farmácias para você economizar comprando medicamentos.

A Nomad busca tratar seus dados pessoais de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais, Lei nº 13.709/2018. Nesse sentido, seus dados serão tratados somente enquanto o processo seletivo perdurar e ou para fins de registro no banco de talentos.

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews health claims. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.

The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value based care, population health, or disease or care management.

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

title: Managing Partner - Diversified Industries
description:
Overview

Your work days are brighter here. At Workday, our culture centers on putting our people first. We look after our people, communities and the planet while remaining profitable. Feel encouraged to shine and bring your brightest version of you to help us grow.

Workday values candidate privacy and data security. We will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through non-Workday sites or to pay recruiting fees or consulting services to apply.

About the Team

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We serve customers with relevant industry stories, practical value realization from Workday’s technology, and peer learning networks. We act like a start-up inside a larger organization, continuously seeking new ways to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About the Role

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We seek to deliver industry stories, practical value realization, and peer learning networks to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About You

  • Collaborate with Account Executives and Service Executives to position and sell or upsell Workday product, deployment, and postproduction services into your customer base and ensure maximum value from the product.
  • Own successful deployment of the Workday solution, drive adoption, guide customers in implementing new features, and sell additional services to support their strategy.
  • Participate in sales cycles to support implementation activities for prospects that will join the portfolio.
  • Drive customer self-sufficiency by ensuring customers understand how to engage with the Workday services organization.
  • Partner with colleagues to position additional value through in-subscription adoption, additional subscription products, or activation of offerings from our platform ecosystem.
  • Participate in partner selection for non-Workday-primed engagements.
  • Guide large, partner-led accounts with global complexity (e.g., M&A and divestitures).
  • Create strategic plans across the customer architecture, attend steering committee meetings, and nurture executive relationships.
  • Provide direction and support to Workday and service partner project teams on scope, budget, timeline, and deployment issues; act as the point of contact to facilitate and resolve escalated issues.
  • Engage other service resources to support account planning and feature adoption strategies.
  • Leverage customer relationships for prospect references as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

10+ years’ experience deploying large, sophisticated Cloud SaaS ERP (HCM & Fins) solutions at a project and program manager level within the Diversified Industries arena.

2+ years direct experience with a cloud-native HR or Finance software (such as Workday, SuccessFactors, NetSuite, or similar) as an implementation leader, business function owner, hands-on configuration resource, or workmate.

8+ years of developing and maintaining C-level relationships resulting in successful partnerships and strategic alignment.

Other Qualifications:

  • Experience within the Diversified Industries customer base. Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage with key stakeholders to build strong relationships and achieve objectives.
  • Ability to empower and lead a matrixed team at multiple levels within an organization.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple customer demands balancing satisfaction with revenue and profitability targets.
  • A dedication to continuous improvement in how we serve customers.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement effective account strategies focused on relationships, growth opportunities, and retention.
  • Strong customer insights skills to analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills to foster collaboration and trust with clients, partners, and colleagues.
  • Strong account planning skills to analyze customer needs and drive retention and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated credibility through honesty, expertise, and clear communication.
  • Strong customer engagement and communication skills to increase satisfaction and sales growth.
  • Ability to identify and understand customer needs through market research and problem-solving to inform product development and service improvements.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

Compensation offers consider geography, experience, skills, duties, and business need. For more information regarding benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.WA.Seattle; Primary Location Base Pay Range: $164,500 USD - $246,700 USD; Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $148,900 USD - $264,400 USD.

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we blend in-person time and remote work to deepen connections and maintain a strong community. Flexibility means you can create a schedule that works for your business, team, and personal needs, with at least 50% in the office or field each quarter when working with customers, prospects, and partners. Remote employees may join offices for important moments.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We seek leaders who are adaptable, resilient, and collaborative; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; and experience working in remote environments.

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, including a competitive PTO package, stock ownership through equity, and remote-first policies allowing up to 180 days of remote work globally (subject to restrictions).

A Few Words About Our Culture

  • You want to see your work create an immediate impact.

This environment is NOT for you if:

Location

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!   • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

EEO Statement

Product Owner Pleno

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Overview

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o Product Owner alocado em um cliente externo, responsável por conectar objetivos do negócio, necessidades dos usuários e execução do time de desenvolvimento. Atuará como dona/dono do backlog, definirá prioridades, conduzirá descobertas e garantirá entregas de valor em ciclos ágeis. Espera-se autonomia para tomar decisões táticas e capacidade de representar a Rethink junto ao cliente com credibilidade e clareza.

Responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir refinamentos, planejamento de sprint e cerimônias ágeis com squads multidisciplinares.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado ao roadmap e às metas do cliente.
  • Realizar product discovery: entrevistas com usuários, análise de dados, hipóteses e testes de validação.
  • Traduzir necessidades do cliente e stakeholders em user stories e critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Aprovar entregas em homologação funcional e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (adoption, uso, performance).
  • Facilitar comunicação entre áreas do cliente, time de design e engenharia, removendo impedimentos.
  • Entregar apresentações executivas e relatórios de progresso.

Qualifications

Para Esta Vaga, é Essencial

  • Experiência como Product Owner em produtos digitais ou squads de desenvolvimento.
  • Forte capacidade de priorização orientada a valor e resultado (outcome driven).
  • Habilidade prática em conduzir discovery e transformar insights em requisitos acionáveis.
  • Conhecimento e prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; habilidade para negociar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Habilidade para gerir relacionamento e expectativas.
  • Perfil generalista: confortável com decisões de produto, UX, métricas e trade-offs técnicos.

Você Pode Se Destacar Se

  • Demonstrar histórico comprovado de entregas que geraram impacto mensurável, habilidade para definir métricas de sucesso e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Demonstrar proatividade, flexibilidade diante de ambiguidade, capacidade de resolver problemas na prática, construir rapport com clientes e desarmar obstáculos com pragmatismo.
  • Tiver background em análises quantitativas (SQL, dashboards, BI) ou experiência com experimentação (A/B testing).
  • Tiver experiência em produtos com múltiplas integrações e stakeholders.
  • Possuir certificações ou formação em Gestão de Produtos, Design Thinking ou áreas correlatas será diferencial.
  • Experiência de atuação alocada em cliente externo.

Você Pode Se Destacar Se (Continuação)

  • Demonstrar histórico de entregas com impacto mensurável, métricas de sucesso e uso de dados para decisão.

description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentations skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Follow us on Instagram lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Voluntary Self Identification

Wellhub is committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive work environment, beginning with the application process. We recognize that we are not all alike, and this is our greatest strength. We hire talented and diverse individuals not only because it is the right thing to do, but also because it strengthens our company. We know that combining our diverse cultures, experiences, and perspectives will help us achieve our mission of making the world a healthier place.

Note: The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS and related environments.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company.
  • The option to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location and benefits — Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona; flexible parental leave benefits; opportunities for cross-functional growth and collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
